Summary: Peppa and Rebecca become mermaids in this marvelously glittery storybook! Based on the hit TV show on Nick Jr. Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit would love to be mermaids! When they come up with a plan to have an under-the-sea party, Peppa gets carried away and invites all her friends over for a swimming disco with starfish-shaped sandwiches and a real beach. There's just one problem ... Mummy and Daddy Pig aren't prepared for this at all! Can Miss Rabbit, Emergency Party Planner and Entertainer Extraordinaire, come to the rescue?
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this Peppa Pig book cute and fun to read, with one describing it as a bonk for toddlers. The story receives positive feedback, and customers appreciate it as a gift, particularly for granddaughters and as a Christmas present. They consider it a great value, and one customer mentions it's a nice addition to their little library.

Author: Scholastic, EOne
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Growing Up & Facts of Life > Family Life > New Experiences
Summary: Peppa Pig is going on vacation with her family!  Peppa Pig and her family are going on a trip to Italy -- magnifico! They pack their bags, fly on an airplane, meet a new friend, and even learn how pizza is made! But what will happen when Peppa keeps leaving her teddy bear behind everywhere they go? Find out in this storybook based on the hit Nick Jr. TV show. This sweet story is perfect for any kid who's ever felt anxious about losing his or her favorite toy.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers love this Peppa Pig book for its familiar storyline and humor, with one review noting how it beautifully captures the excitement of packing. Moreover, the book receives positive feedback for its readability, with one customer mentioning they've been reading it daily for months, and its travel value, with another highlighting how it helps repeat travel intricacies. Additionally, customers find it cute, good value for money, and appreciate its color palette, while also considering it a great gift option.
